text: A type A is contractible (h-level -2) iff:
choices: A has exactly one element (up to definitional equality)
Σ(a:A). Π(x:A). a=x (there is a center to which every element is connected by a path)
all identity types of A are empty
explanation: isContr(A) := Σ(a:A).Π(x:A).a=x — a center a and contracting homotopy to every x.
